hero.title2: and the heart of Your City right at your door.
hero.description: Located on Your City’s historic pedestrian street, just a 5-minute walk from the main transport hub, this basecamp is built for travelers to rest and connect, combining custom quiet pods with mountain views and social evenings on the rooftop terrace.

heroHighlights: Privacy pods with curtains, reading lights, sockets, and lockers
Rooftop sunsets with mountain and city views
Historic home on vibrant Main Street street
A lively, social atmosphere perfect for meeting travelers over cold beers and raki

quickFacts.title: Privacy Pods
quickFacts.text: Spacious privacy pods in our mixed dorm create a personal bedroom feel within a social space

quickFacts.title: Boutique Dorms
quickFacts.text: Boutique 4-bed female or male dorms, offering a bright, high-end sanctuary for peaceful stays

quickFacts.title: Included Perks
quickFacts.text: Included: Free Breakfast (excl. off-season), luggage storage, shared kitchen, fast WiFi & 24h access

includedServices.title: Free Breakfast
includedServices.description: Fresh, locally-sourced breakfast (excl. off-season) including morning espresso. Early take-away breakfast for hikers

includedServices.title: Modern Facilities
includedServices.description: Clean modern bathrooms, hot high-pressure showers, and high-speed WiFi in all rooms.

includedServices.title: Shared Kitchen
includedServices.description: Well-equipped kitchen for guest use, including refrigerators, stoves, an espresso and ice machine.

includedServices.title: Community
includedServices.description: Regular social events, daytrips, movie nights, family dinners, games and a helpful WhatsApp community.

includedServices.title: Adventure Ready
includedServices.description: Transport and tour arrangements, laundry service, and secure luggage storage — all sorted from the hostel.

addOnServices.title: Tours & Transport
addOnServices.description: Hassle-free shuttle booking to regional (€12), regional (€26), regional River (€35 - includes €5 discount), and regional Lake (€36).

addOnServices.title: Guest Laundry
addOnServices.description: Use our washing machine (€5) and dryer (€2) or air-dry your clothes on our clotheslines for free.

addOnServices.title: Bike Rentals
addOnServices.description: Explore Your City on two wheels for just €5/day. Rentals located right across the street.

extendReasons.title: Sleep well, still meet people
extendReasons.description: Privacy pods give you a reset button after a long day in the mountains, so the social side of hostel life stays a choice, not a chore.

extendReasons.title: Rooftop nights, unmissable vibes
extendReasons.description: Sunset views, lively conversation, and cold drinks make it simple to connect. It’s the social heart of Your City, where every night has a story.

extendReasons.title: Everything starts right outside
extendReasons.description: You’re already on Your City's main pedestrian street, surrounded by local eats, museums, and nightlife. Whether you're heading to the Alps or the coast, transport is just a short walk away.

extendReasons.title: Staff who keep things straightforward
extendReasons.description: Honest local tips, fresh and locally-sourced breakfast, and help with your hiking route. We handle the logistics so you can focus on the trip.

experiencePillars.title: Your Local Basecamp
experiencePillars.description: Drop your bags and explore the best local experiences nearby. Use this section for tours, city highlights, day trips, food, culture, or outdoor adventures that fit this property.
experiencePillars.alt: Hiking and mountain views near Your City, Your Countryn Alps trips from Template Hostel

experiencePillars.title: Right in the Center
experiencePillars.description: Step out our front door directly onto Main Street, Your City’s main pedestrian street. From your first morning espresso to late-night drinks, the city's best food, culture, and rhythm are literally at your doorstep.
experiencePillars.alt: Pedestrian street scene near Template Hostel on Main Street, Your City

featuredMoments.title: Movie Nights and Spontaneous Socials
featuredMoments.description: Whether it’s rooftop raki or exploring the local craft beer scene, we prioritize memorable moments that make it easy for everyone to join.
featuredMoments.alt: Traditional food event at Template Hostel

featuredMoments.title: Explore the Bicycle Capital
featuredMoments.description: Your City runs on two wheels. Grab a rental and explore the city's flat streets, lake paths, and cafes exactly how the locals do.
featuredMoments.alt: Bike tour event from Template Hostel

featuredMoments.title: River Days at the regional
featuredMoments.description: We head out to the river regularly for swimming and sun. These trips are a hostel favorite, a chance to relax and spend the afternoon with a great crew.
featuredMoments.alt: Guests enjoying an evening event at Template Hostel

featuredMoments.title: Rooftop Magic
featuredMoments.description: The rooftop is the social heart of the hostel: mountain light at sunset, city views after dark, and a pulse that keeps going from the first drink to the last chat.
featuredMoments.alt: Guests relaxing on the Template Hostel rooftop at sunset

experienceLogisticsFeatures.title: Free Luggage Storage
experienceLogisticsFeatures.description: Drop your main backpack in our secure storage. Hike the regional trail carrying only what you actually need.

experienceLogisticsFeatures.title: Transport & Logistics
experienceLogisticsFeatures.description: We provide honest, up-to-date info on furgon (minibus) schedules, regional Lake ferries, and regional River boat trips.

experienceLogisticsFeatures.title: The Post-Hike Reset
experienceLogisticsFeatures.description: Return from the mountains to a hot shower, A/C, crisp linens, and a cold drink on the rooftop.

socialConnectionFeatures.title: The regional River Escape
socialConnectionFeatures.description: Just outside the city, the regional River offers a cool, scenic contrast to the Alps. We organize regular group swimming trips to our favorite spots along the water for a perfect, sun-drenched afternoon.

socialConnectionFeatures.title: Spontaneous Socials
socialConnectionFeatures.description: Whether it’s rooftop raki shots or exploring the local craft beer scene, we prioritize high-energy moments that make it easy for everyone to join. It’s all about the social rhythm of the city.

socialConnectionFeatures.title: Bicycle Capital Access
socialConnectionFeatures.description: Your City is best explored on two wheels. Grab a rental from across the street and navigate the flat streets, historic center, and scenic lake paths exactly how the locals do.
